title: Hero
description: The opening section of a landing page, composing the @moderno-ui/{framework} Alert, Badge, Button and Skeleton primitives: a kicker, a serif title, a subtitle and a primary and a secondary call to action, with its own loading and error renders; responds to its container (@container) — the actions move side by side at @sm, the title and subtitle step up at @md and the block takes more room above and below at @lg.
